audit.description: Changed production code replaces `requests` imports with real `httpx` imports in `hxl/input.py` and `hxl/scripts.py`, and uses `httpx.get`, `httpx.head`, and `httpx.post` in migrated request paths. Static and dynamic evidence show no production `requests` imports or source API access, while dynamic target events originate from installed `site-packages/httpx`, with no local target provider detected.
evidence: hxl/input.py import hunk removes requests and adds httpx; request calls changed to httpx.get/httpx.head/httpx.post.
hxl/scripts.py import hunk removes requests and adds httpx; remote JSON fetch changed to httpx.get.
requirements.txt and setup.py replace requests dependency with httpx.
Static anti-cheat file checks: hxl/input.py and hxl/scripts.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false.
Dynamic target origin is installed site-packages/httpx/__init__.py, not a repository-local provider.
reasons: Changed production files meaningfully use httpx APIs.
No changed production file imports or dynamically accesses requests.
Dynamic evidence records production httpx imports and zero production requests imports.
No fake local httpx provider or shim is indicated.
